svg.text: A prompt changes the input. Fine-tuning changes the model.

text.tspan: an input, and the output you want
A model is billions of numbers called weights. Full
fine-tuning adjusts every one of them.
LoRA freezes those weights and adds a small adapter: a
few million new numbers beside them.
Your examples train only the adapter: up to 10,000 times
fewer numbers, in the LoRA paper.
